publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: A touch convenience method can be an empty stub
record.method: Exact-build interface inspection and constructed packet-vector checks
record.observation: The inspected absolute-pointer convenience method is empty in this build. The original touch path instead passes through a user-client queue, a framework parser and a digitizer conversion plugin.
record.limits: A synthetic packet encoder and a static interface map do not prove live Goodix acquisition, event lifetimes or application-visible touch.

records.access: Private project record; original material is not distributed

exhibits.title: The inspected boundary is concrete
rows: Immediate return in the inspected build
exhibits.interpretation: The method name is not evidence of an implementation. These field offsets identify the inspected layout; they do not supply a complete validated packet format.

exhibits.title: The consumer path identified by inspection
rows: MultitouchSupport raw-packet parser and contact callback
exhibits.interpretation: This is a static interface chain. Event acquisition, lifetime, down/move/up behavior and a physical Goodix-to-application path remain unvalidated in this snapshot.
